Definition
[the Berger--Cheeger construction $G\times _GM$]

Source: petersen:page-0169 ↗ def:pet-ch4-left-invariant-metric-lie Fix $(M,g)$ and a Lie group $G$ with right-invariant metric $(\cdot ,\cdot )$ acting by isometries on $M$. Then $G$ acts freely by isometries on $(G\times M,\, g_\lambda )$, $g_\lambda =\lambda (\cdot ,\cdot )+g$ ($\lambda >0$), via $h\cdot (x,p)=(xh^{-1},hp)$. The quotient map $Q:G\times M\to M=(G\times M)/G$, $Q(x,p)=xp$, exhibits $M$ (diffeomorphic to the quotient) with a submersion metric $g_\lambda $, called the Berger–Cheeger perturbation of $g$.
